## Professional identity

Teja K G is a mechanical and manufacturing engineer who solves physical manufacturing problems by combining engineering, automation, sensing, electronics and software. His differentiator is the ability to move across the mechanical-electrical-software boundary while keeping manufacturing reality and validation evidence central to the decision.

## Measurable engineering impact

- Reduced manufacturing cycle time by 90% using an IMU-based manufacturing fixture, with more than $1M in annual savings.
- Eliminated line-down events caused by the top-plate shaft jamming in the chamber-hole assembly condition described in the fixture case study.
- Reduced hardware test cycles by 50% with Python-based hardware validation automation.
- Reduced assembly trial-and-error time by 30% using DELMIA simulation.
- Reduced wet-deposition tool cycle time by 5% using Value Stream Mapping and ZBRA matrix analysis.
- Developed an AI/LLM-based Test Procedure Instruction automation solution with an estimated $120k/year saving opportunity.

## Engineering case studies

- IMU-Based Manufacturing Fixture: measured absolute top-plate and chamber position to quantify planar misalignment; validated with real assembly technicians; 90% cycle-time reduction and more than $1M annual savings.
- Automated Hardware Validation: Python-based automation reduced hardware test cycles by 50%.
- Assembly Workflow Simulation: DELMIA-based simulation reduced trial-and-error time by 30%.
- Critical Mobile X-Ray Supplier Transition: supplier prototypes, documentation, V&V, risk retirement and fixture-based deferred assembly protected the customer commissioning timeline.
- Test Procedure Instruction Automation: computer vision + LLM hackathon solution; finalist; estimated $120k/year opportunity.
